decision.reason: [ev-c05c58b487cc] removes only the setup where Cilium itself runs etcd in the pod network, and it points to k8s_install_etcd for other ways to use etcd. So Cilium still works with etcd, and product-relationship:etcd removed is too broad. The excerpt doesn't name the setting, flag, Helm value or resource that enabled the Cilium-managed etcd mode, so no correct subject can be built. It also only refers readers to alternatives without saying a migration is mandatory, so the migration family isn't supported either. Needed: the artifact or doc naming the removed option, and what happens to clusters still using it after upgrade.
